description: This Java source file defines an exception class 'UnsupportedMediaTypeException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a request with an unsupported media type was made, including methods for constructing the exception with detailed information, parsing from JSON, and building instances using a builder pattern.

classes.name: UnsupportedMediaTypeException
classes.description: An immutable exception class representing an unsupported media-type error, extending DittoRuntimeException, with constructors, message builders, and JSON parsing capabilities.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A fluent builder class for constructing instances of UnsupportedMediaTypeException, providing methods to set properties and build the exception object.

methods.name: withDetailedInformationBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for UnsupportedMediaTypeException with detailed info about the unsupported media type used and supported media types.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an UnsupportedMediaTypeException from a JSON object, extracting details as needed.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the exception with updated headers.
